desc: When seconds matter, the Bel Air XL - EMT is built to perform. Designed for first responders and everyday heroes, this USA-made knife combines MagnaCut edge retention with a safe, purpose-driven design. The blunt tip prevents punctures while cutting through seatbelts or clothing, and the carbide glassbreaker tip provides rapid window entry in emergencies. Partially serrated and finished in rugged BlackWash, the blade tackles tough materials with confidence. Textured G10 scales ensure a secure grip, while KVT ball bearings and the DuraLock system deliver fast, reliable one-handed operation when it counts.
